notes: The Control Panel's type is now measured against the approved design rather than judged by eye. Diffed element by element in both running windows: page title, section eyebrow, row label, row value, note and chip. Five carried real…

One token did three elements' work: the smallest step is 10.5px in the design, not 10. It carries the eyebrow, the note and the discovery chip, so the half-pixel was three elements' worth of difference rather than a rounding argument.
A note now sits one step BELOW the rows it explains. At 11.5px it was the same size as the text it was subordinate to, so it read as another sentence rather than an aside.
Values are set in regular. In medium, every key/value row looked like it was being insisted upon — a reading is not emphasis.
